title: Regex builder feature coverage
manualReviewed: 2026-10-17 (official RegexBuddy manual, topic families as listed in the adoption checklist)
manualVersionBaseline: unavailable: no advertised product version was verified
method: Each family from the checklist is expanded into topics. A topic is implemented only when its behavior is exercised by a named automated test. Topics whose behavior needs the built application to be observed stay partial, because the interactive surface was verified only against a fake DOM in Node. Topics the JavaScript engine or the renderer cannot provide are unsupported with the reason.

statusMeaning.implemented: Behavior exists and is exercised by the listed automated tests.
statusMeaning.partial: Some behavior exists; the reason says what is missing or unverified.
statusMeaning.unsupported: Not provided here; the reason says why.

topics.topic: Guided insertion of syntax at the selection, wrapping the selected text
tests: token palette explains every token and inserts selection-aware syntax
Create inserts a token at the selection, explains it and adds a needed flag

topics.topic: Plain-language explanation for every palette token in English and Cantonese
tests: token palette explains every token and inserts selection-aware syntax

topics.topic: Insert literal text with every special character escaped
tests: escaped literal text can never change the expression structure

topics.topic: Characters, shorthand and Unicode property classes, anchors, groups, quantifiers, lookarounds, references, v-flag class sets, inline modifiers
tests: syntax tree covers groups, classes, quantifiers, references and lookarounds
v flag class operators and nested classes are parsed
topics.reason: Every JavaScript construct has a palette entry or parses, but the palette is not a complete property browser: only three Unicode property examples are offered, and no per-flavor palette exists.

topics.topic: Browse every documented Unicode property, script and block
topics.reason: No property catalogue is bundled. Properties can be typed and are validated by the engine, but they are not browsable.

topics.topic: Atomic groups, possessive quantifiers, recursion, subroutines, balancing groups, conditionals, comments and free-spacing mode
topics.reason: The JavaScript engine rejects these constructs, and no other engine is bundled. The capability matrix reports each one as unsupported by this engine.

topics.topic: Syntax assistance that follows the selected flavor
topics.reason: Only the JavaScript flavor has a palette and a parser; other flavors are reached by static conversion.

topics.topic: Replacement text parsed independently and explained part by part
tests: replacement templates parse into explained parts matching JavaScript rules

topics.topic: Replacement preview matching the native result, with whole-match, group, named group, before and after context
tests: replacement preview equals the native replacement including backreferences

topics.topic: Convert replacement text to other flavors and refuse constructs without an equivalent
tests: replacement templates convert per flavor and refuse what has no equivalent

topics.topic: Conditional and case-changing replacement syntax
topics.reason: JavaScript replacement strings have no conditionals or case conversion.

topics.topic: Guided insertion into the replacement text
topics.reason: The replacement is typed by hand; the tab explains each part but offers no insertion palette.

topics.topic: Syntax tree with source positions for every node
tests: syntax tree covers groups, classes, quantifiers, references and lookarounds
every node carries its source range so the tree can select pattern text

topics.topic: English and Cantonese explanation for every node kind
tests: every node kind has an English and Cantonese explanation

topics.topic: Report syntax problems in unfinished or invalid expressions without failing
tests: invalid intermediate edits are reported as structured errors without throwing

topics.topic: Backtracking and cost warnings
tests: risk notes flag nested repetition and long expressions as heuristics
topics.reason: Warnings are static heuristics. They do not measure the pattern.

topics.topic: Selecting a node selects its text, and moving the caret highlights the node
tests: Analyze renders a tree for the pattern and selects source text when a node is activated
topics.reason: Verified only against a fake DOM in Node; not observed in the built application.

topics.topic: Adjustable explanation detail and export as text, Markdown and JSON
topics.reason: Implemented in the interface but exercised by no test; downloads were not observed.

topics.topic: Edit the pattern by editing tree nodes
topics.reason: The tree is read-only; edits are made in the expression editor.

topics.topic: Select a target flavor with honest execution status
tests: only the JavaScript flavor is marked as executing
flavors other than JavaScript are never executed and say so

topics.topic: Static conversion to Python, .NET, Java, PCRE2, Ruby, Go and Rust syntax with incompatibility reports
tests: named groups and references use each flavor syntax
anchors become exact end-of-text anchors and flags become inline modifiers
lookaround and backreference support is reported per engine
lookbehind width rules are enforced per engine
Unicode escapes and properties are converted or refused with a reason
JavaScript-specific syntax is refused instead of mistranslated
class characters that mean something else in the target are escaped

topics.topic: Warn about matching differences (shorthand classes, dot, line anchors, unmatched references)
tests: semantic differences are warned about, not hidden

topics.topic: Compare the current expression and replacement across every flavor
tests: flavor comparison reports every flavor for the current expression
Use generates code and Flavors compares every target for the current expression

topics.topic: Show the real engine and probe its capabilities
tests: lexical explanation identifies groups and warns about nested repetition

topics.topic: Run matches in Python, .NET, Java, PCRE2, Ruby, Go or Rust engines
topics.reason: No other engine is bundled or reachable from the renderer. Converted patterns are shown but never executed, and conversion cannot prove equal matching.

topics.topic: Accept a converted pattern as the working expression
topics.reason: The search field and the test engine are JavaScript; a converted pattern would not run. The original is always preserved and the converted text can be copied.

topics.topic: Choose exact engine versions
topics.reason: Flavors are not versioned; only the running JavaScript engine version string is shown.

topics.topic: Match list with positions, line and column, and a capture group table including unmatched groups
tests: match results expose positions, line and column, groups and unmatched captures
no-match, empty pattern and plain text behave
match count is capped and reported as truncated

topics.topic: Zero-width matches and astral characters handled by code point
tests: zero-width matches terminate and advance by whole code points
Unicode and astral text keep correct indices

topics.topic: Live highlighting of matches and groups in the test text
tests: highlight segments split text at match and group boundaries without markup
Test shows matches, group data and highlighting from the engine
topics.reason: Segmentation is tested; the rendered colours and underlines were not observed in the built application.

topics.topic: Previous and next match navigation
tests: Test shows matches, group data and highlighting from the engine
topics.reason: Navigation text is tested against a fake DOM; keyboard behavior in the built application was not observed.

topics.topic: Replace mode with a preview of the result
tests: replacement preview equals the native replacement including backreferences
Replace, Split and Debug each produce their result for the same expression

topics.topic: Split mode, including capture pieces
tests: split behaves like JavaScript split, including capture pieces

topics.topic: Reusable test cases with expected match or no-match outcomes
tests: expected outcome cases pass and fail correctly

topics.topic: Bounded pattern, text, matches and runtime
tests: invalid patterns, flags and oversized input are rejected before running
isolated regex protocol preserves Unicode captures and replacement previews

topics.topic: Hexadecimal view, encodings and line-ending controls
topics.reason: Test text is a JavaScript string; byte encodings and a hexadecimal view are not offered.

topics.topic: Line and page scopes, continue-from-cursor matching
topics.reason: Matching always covers the whole test text. The Debug tab can start from a position.

topics.topic: Load test text from files and the clipboard; write results to files
topics.reason: Results can be copied and a text file can be loaded for Grep; the main test text is typed or pasted and no result file output exists. Not exercised by a test.

topics.topic: Attempt-level trace: every start position tried, with leading elements matched on failure
tests: attempt trace finds exactly the matches a native scan finds
failed attempts report how far the leading elements matched
attempt trace is bounded

topics.topic: Step forward and backward through attempts and jump to the next match
tests: Replace, Split and Debug each produce their result for the same expression
topics.reason: Stepping is only smoke-tested against a fake DOM; not observed in the built application.

topics.topic: Internal backtracking steps, expandable attempts and synchronized tree selection
topics.reason: The JavaScript engine exposes no internal steps. The tab states that it shows attempts only and does not reproduce engine optimizations.

topics.topic: Measured time of the expression on growing copies of the test text, within a time budget
tests: benchmark times growing copies of the sample and states what it cannot count

topics.topic: Step and backtracking counts
topics.reason: The engine does not expose them; only wall-clock timing is reported and labelled as such.

topics.topic: Compare several patterns on matching and non-matching subjects
topics.reason: Only the current expression is timed, on the current test text.

topics.topic: Match, first match, all matches, replace and split snippets for JavaScript, Python, C# and PowerShell
tests: generated JavaScript is executable and does what the action says
generated code exists for every language and action, or states why not

topics.topic: Language-correct quoting of patterns and replacements
tests: string quoting follows each language rules
generated Python and C# literals round-trip the converted pattern

topics.topic: Refuse to generate code when conversion is unsupported
tests: generated code exists for every language and action, or states why not

topics.topic: Java, PHP, Ruby, Go, Rust and other language snippets
topics.reason: Only four languages have snippet templates, although patterns can be converted for seven flavors.

topics.topic: Edit code templates and function choices
topics.reason: Templates are fixed in source.

topics.topic: Save, load, remove and search named expressions with description, replacement and flavor
tests: saved expressions keep description, replacement and flavor and survive a reload
library search, update and rejection of invalid entries
Library saves an expression locally and loads it back

topics.topic: Import and export a library as JSON with validation
tests: import and export round-trip without losing extra fields and reject bad documents

topics.topic: Parameters with defaults, substituted as escaped literals
tests: parameters are listed with defaults and substituted as escaped literals

topics.topic: Each search field owns its own library, history and state
tests: each builder keeps its own state, history and library
saved expressions keep description, replacement and flavor and survive a reload
topics.reason: Isolation is tested with a fake DOM and in-memory storage; a real window with two live search fields was not observed.

topics.topic: Store test text with a saved expression
topics.reason: Test text is deliberately never saved, for privacy.

topics.topic: Several named collection files with tags and folders
topics.reason: Each search field has a single local library.

topics.topic: Grep a supplied list of lines with counts and invert
tests: grep over a supplied list counts lines and matches and can invert
Grep filters a supplied list

topics.topic: Search files and folders with masks, recursion and encodings
topics.reason: The renderer has no folder access. A main-process route with preview, cancellation and backups would be required and does not exist.

topics.topic: Replace in files with preview, backups and restore
topics.reason: No file replacement is offered, so no original data can be changed.

topics.topic: Undo and redo of pattern, flags and replacement
tests: undo and redo walk the edit history and branch on new edits
history is capped and one instance never affects another

topics.topic: Recall recent expressions, with opt-in persistent history that never stores test text
tests: saved expressions keep description, replacement and flavor and survive a reload
topics.reason: The persistent opt-in store is tested; the recall list in the interface is only smoke-tested.

topics.topic: Several independent experiments side by side
topics.reason: A builder holds one experiment per search field.

topics.topic: Launch from and return results to external tools
topics.reason: No external tool integration exists in this application.

topics.topic: Command-line arguments, action files and automation interfaces
topics.reason: The builder runs inside the application only.

topics.topic: Copy patterns, results and code to the clipboard
topics.reason: Copy buttons exist; no test exercises the clipboard and the unavailable-clipboard message was not observed.

topics.topic: Explanations beside every token, flag, replacement part and tree node
tests: every node kind has an English and Cantonese explanation
token palette explains every token and inserts selection-aware syntax
topics.reason: Inline explanations exist; there is no context-sensitive help window.

topics.topic: English and Cantonese copy
tests: the builder mounts one panel per mode and every mode has English and Cantonese labels
topics.reason: Strings go through the surface's two-language helper, but bilingual mode and personal wording were not observed in the built application.

topics.topic: Keyboard access, focus order, accessible names and live regions
topics.reason: Controls are Material components with accessible names and tree rows handle Enter and Space, but no screen reader or keyboard pass was run.

topics.topic: Configurable panels, docking, fonts, palettes and editor preferences
topics.reason: The builder is a fixed anchored panel that follows the application's own appearance settings.

topics.topic: Vendor support, sales and community services
topics.reason: Not applicable: these are services of another vendor, not behavior of this builder.
